title: What we will and won't generate: sloth bear
storyboard: Generate (AI, labelled): flat diagram of a sloth bear's front-tooth gap; no realistic animal footage

scenes.headline: We won't AI-generate a sloth bear doing anything.
Sloth bear mums really do carry cubs on their backs.
AI diagram (labelled): the gap in its front teeth
scenes.body: Missing upper incisors let it suck up termites.

scenes.headline: Diagrams can be generated. Behaviour must be real.
scenes.body: Every generated frame carries an AI label.

caption:
Real behaviour, real photos. AI only for the diagram.

Sloth bears are the only bears that routinely carry their young on their backs; cubs ride on a shaggy 'saddle' of fur until about 6 to 9 months old.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo. Tooth diagram: AI-generated (labelled).  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Medium risk: shows the boundary of the format — AI only for a labelled, non-photoreal diagram, while the remarkable behaviour is shown with a real wild photo.
